blind.description: A low square wooden frame or crate containing a stacked pyramid of spherical carved stone ammunition. The wooden frame has reinforced corner posts and horizontal timber sides with stylized wood grain texturing. Inside, rough-chiseled round stones in shades of grey and warm tan are neatly piled. Geometry is clean, stylized, and solid throughout with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A square wooden border with four corner posts enclosing a pyramid pile of round stone balls, centered with a single top stone resting on lower concentric spheres.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around one-third the height of the figure) and roughly 2.5 feet wide square.
